objective: Produce a durable, redacted UPI index triage report from data/ without mutating records.

when: before merge of data/ or schema changes
user asks for index triage or debug-index
not_when: experimental physics claims need laboratory evidence
source records must be rewritten in place

steps: Manager opens a ledger row with task_id, owner, deadline and idempotency key.
Scanner runs a read-only debug-index over the declared root and writes the report artifact.
Independent verifier checks finding codes, redaction, and that no source file changed.
Manager decides advance, retry or escalate from evidence only.
If EST or ERR findings remain, stop at the approval boundary.
anti_patterns: Manager performing the scan instead of routing it
Treating scanner and verifier as the same worker
Mutating data/ to make the report green
Calling a software test experimental verification

acceptance_tests.criterion: Workflow, skill, routine, ledger and handoff examples validate against their schemas.
debug-index report sets verification_type to software_test and redacts source values.
Scanner has no write capability on data/.

changelog.change: Three identical baselines recorded; weekly routine compares reports to known-findings.json.
Initial index-triage skill for the first governed workflow.

confusion_guard: This skill is an operational procedure for software validation, not a scientific experiment.
